Fixed in `src/t_zset.c:4264`: `blockingGenericZpopCommand` now blocks only on the parsed key arguments (`keys`, `numkeys`) instead of `c->argv+1`/`c->argc-2`, so BZMPOP no longer waits on timeout/numkeys/MIN/MAX/COUNT values.

Validation: full `unit/type/zset` suite passes, including the regression test `BZMPOP should not blocks on non key arguments - #10762`.
